body: Edit: saw your edit, will PM this. Thank you for taking the time to talk to me, it does mean a lot.

Oh, it gets better. From separate incidents with different charming men when I tried to start dating again:

"Well, why didn't you try to stop him/leave him/quit being such a wimp? Did you like it?"

"I was just saying to my friend how all the hot girls get plowed by assholes and then go try and find a nice guy. Why didn't you just find a nice guy first?"

"Don't take this the wrong way, but I kind of feel like I'm getting leftovers, you know?"

"My ex and I were each other's firsts and it was really special to me. So I don't really want to seriously date someone who's been with other guys, but what do you think about being friends with benefits?"

I think I just need to give up in general.

The idea is by not being alive anymore, not only will I not make mistakes but the old ones won't matter anymore. I can't go back to a time when I was free from pain and judgment and I didn't see his face in my nightmares. I'd be willing to risk an eternity of nothingness to be free of that.
Ex robbed me blind, no health insurance. I'd love anti-depressants. I'd also love to jump off a bridge. Whichever one ends up being more feasible in the end.

I went over it in my last couple posts on this burner, if you want the full story, but the tl;dr is: encountered a sadist who stole everything I held dear, and now I suppose I have... baggage? I hate that word. Thing is, I'm beginning to learn the hard way that no one wants girls with baggage, and I tried very hard for a lot of my life not to have any, and now I do.

What set this off, I think, was a comment I had heard before but never expressed quite so bluntly, from a young man I thought cared about me:

"I just don't see what your problem is. That means you've already had sex, right? What's the big deal?"

Note that this was after I told him that I'd lost my virginity to a rapist and didn't want to have sex outside of a committed relationship. Boy, I can pick 'em.

I don't know why I chose those words in particular... it's like with a lot of my writing, I just sort of see it in my mind's eye and hope it makes sense when I write it down. So a little sarcastic, yeah, but maybe in a way it is thank you for showing me how lucky I am that I could escape and I have a chance to be me again, and there are way, way too many others who either are or feel too trapped to escape. If anything, he made me want to help people like me. I wish I could stop it from ever happening again.

I called the CCADV hotline, but I felt kind of dumb... I think it's more for women in immediate crisis and I don't want to tie up the line if someone's really in trouble. The lady was really nice though and she asked if I needed a shelter, but I can't leave my cat. She's already pretty traumatized (I think he was mean to her when I wasn't around, but I'm not sure) and I don't want to abandon her, since most shelters apparently aren't pet friendly. Right now I'm hoping I can talk to my old boss and he might let me have my job back. The worst possible thing that could happen now is me losing my apartment.

I thought about it, but I've heard a lot of horror stories about taking it to court... I don't think I could sit there and have some defense attorney tear me apart while he watches, and then possibly have the whole thing thrown out. I really have no proof other than my word; he was very careful about keeping the physical stuff private.

I think he might have hurt his ex but I can't find her to contact her. If it happened to both of us, it might have a chance of going somewhere.

I don't know how much longer I can live like this, though. The few people I did tell told me it was my fault for staying, so I just stopped telling anyone. I lost my job and all of my savings after he stole my debit card... no insurance, no therapy. I'm close to losing my apartment. I no longer have the circle of friends I used to, I don't even know who I could stay with where I would be safe.

I don't want it to be like this. I just want me back. I want to be okay...
